# Raft Design

> Raft Design is an AI-native brand and product design studio based in Los Angeles, working in English and Japanese. It was founded by Lance Shields, a designer with 25+ years of experience who previously led design at Adobe and Walmart. Raft helps startups and established companies turn new technology into brands and products people trust. The core offer is the Design Foundation Sprint, a four-week fixed-price engagement for funded startups that delivers a brand system, core product screens, and a documented design system.

Last updated: 2026-10-18

For a single-file summary of the whole site, read [ai.md](https://raftdesign.studio/ai.md) (Japanese: [ja/ai.md](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/ai.md)).

Work labels used below. "Raft engagement" means a project listed on the site as Raft's own work. "Founder's prior work" means work Lance Shields did in a staff role at the named company before founding Raft.

## Studio
- [Home (English)](https://raftdesign.studio/): Positioning, approach, featured work, the two main offerings, journal, the Design Intelligence Engine site scanner, and FAQ.
- [Home (Japanese)](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/): Japanese version of the home page.
- [About](https://raftdesign.studio/about/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/about/): The studio, founder Lance Shields' background (Adobe, Walmart, a decade leading a Tokyo design team, an SF design studio), awards, and how Raft builds with AI.
- [Services](https://raftdesign.studio/services/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/services/): Five service areas: branding, digital products, websites, AI interfaces and agents, and globalization.
- [Labs](https://raftdesign.studio/labs/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/labs/): Six self-initiated experiments in AI product design, prototyping, and emerging tools.
- [Contact](https://raftdesign.studio/contact/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/contact/): Contact form, email, phone, office address, and consultation booking.

## Offerings
- [Design Foundation Sprint](https://raftdesign.studio/design-foundation/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/design-foundation/): A four-week fixed-price engagement for funded startups. Brand first, then the product screens that express it, delivered as a tokenized, documented design system. Core is $28,000, Full System is $34,000, and Land & Expand fractional design leadership is $10,000 per month.
- [AI-Ready Design Systems](https://raftdesign.studio/design-system/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/design-system/): Design systems that give a team and its AI tools the same source of truth: brand rules, voice, tokens, components, templates, and DESIGN.md. Links to a real example, the [Raft Design & Brand System deck](https://raftdesign.studio/design-system-deck/) (English only; the Japanese page links to the English deck).

## Work
- [Work index (English)](https://raftdesign.studio/work/)
- [Work index (Japanese)](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/)
- [LegalOn: Global AI Brand Platform](https://raftdesign.studio/work/legalon/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/legalon/): Brand and product platform for seven AI products built on the "ON" concept, with teams in Tokyo and the U.S. Label: Raft engagement.
- [AI Design LA: Community Platform and Brand Identity](https://raftdesign.studio/work/ai-design-la/): Visual identity and website for a Los Angeles AI design community that Lance Shields co-founded. English page only. Label: Raft engagement.
- [Fitbit: Interactive Retail Experience](https://raftdesign.studio/work/fitbit/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/fitbit/): Guided in-store product experience that launched across 1,000+ Best Buy and Target stores in three months. Label: Raft engagement.
- [California Walnuts: Brand and Digital Experience](https://raftdesign.studio/work/california-walnuts/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/california-walnuts/): Creative direction and UX/UI design for walnuts.org. Label: Raft engagement.
- [That's Not Cool: Webby Award-Winning Non-Profit Site](https://raftdesign.studio/work/thats-not-cool/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/thats-not-cool/): Redesign of a teen digital-relationships site for Futures Without Violence. Label: Raft engagement.
- [Modere: Japanese Market Platform Redesign](https://raftdesign.studio/work/modere/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/modere/): Modere.co.jp rebuilt from a storefront into a community-powered wellness platform. Label: Raft engagement.
- [Walmart: AI-First Shopping Experience](https://raftdesign.studio/work/walmart/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/walmart/): AI shopping features layered onto search. Label: Founder's prior work (Walmart).
- [Adobe Express Photos: 0-to-1 AI Product Design](https://raftdesign.studio/work/adobe-express-photos/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/adobe-express-photos/): AI-powered desktop image editor. Label: Founder's prior work (Adobe).
- [Adobe Express Enterprise: Embed SDK and Plugin Ecosystem](https://raftdesign.studio/work/adobe-express-enterprise/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/adobe-express-enterprise/): Embeddable editors, SDK, and plugin marketplace. Label: Founder's prior work (Adobe).
- [Modular Suite for XD: Design Collaboration Tools](https://raftdesign.studio/work/modular-suite-xd/) / [日本語](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/work/modular-suite-xd/): Three collaboration plugins for Adobe XD. Label: Founder's prior work (Adobe).

## AI Tools
- [AI Tools (English)](https://raftdesign.studio/tools/): A reviewed, regularly updated list of the AI tools Raft uses for reasoning, design, and build, including tools dropped and why.
- [AI Tools (Japanese)](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/tools/): Japanese version of the AI Tools page.
- [Design Intelligence Engine](https://design-intelligence-engine.lovable.app/?lang=en): Site scanner that scores how well a site is designed and built, including how readable it is to LLMs and search. It also opens from the "Scan your site" button on the home page.
